# Pitex 1.0.2

This release reduces the wait before embedded editing-preview updates and adds
text selection and copying to the Ubuntu PDF viewer.

## Changes

- Embedded editing preview: reduce the edit coalescing window from 100 ms to
  16 ms while preserving IME composition guards. Use Rust O2 with ThinLTO and
  native font-layout O3 after comparing repeated-edit performance.
- Ubuntu PDF preview: select text by dragging in either direction and copy it
  with Ctrl+C. Show selection highlights and clear them when the PDF, page or
  zoom changes. Ctrl+click remains available for inverse SyncTeX.
- Add a separate Pitex Nightly channel with its own settings, caches and update
  feed. Stable Pitex and Pitex Nightly can be installed together.

## Install

Pitex 1.0.0 and 1.0.1 update to 1.0.2 from Settings or, with automatic installation
enabled, at launch. For Homebrew installations, run `brew update` and
`brew upgrade --cask pitex`.

Builds from the earlier 2.x line do not update automatically; install 1.0.2 from
the downloads below. Pitex Nightly continues to use its separate update channel.

## Downloads

Downloads include the macOS ARM64 DMG, Ubuntu 22.04 and 24.04 AMD64 DEBs,
Windows AMD64 installer and portable ZIP, the Ubuntu installer, and SHA256SUMS.
Windows remains beta.
